items.title: Designer Teens
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Why wear normal clothes when you can wear designer?

+ 12 rich teens in designer clothing
+ Stylish outfits

items.title: Dinosaur Furniture
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Take your decorating skills back to the Jurassic era! With hundreds of dino themed furniture and real dinosaurs for you to hatch and ride, you'll be able to roleplay in the pre-historic times!
+Tools to change size, color, etc
+4 rideable dinosaurs and 1 jungle buggy
+55 unique models
+880 textures/variants
+7 skins
+Pre-historic mansions and houses

items.title: Pro Skaters
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Roll down the street in style with these skater skins! Show off your cool tricks and look cute while doing it! There's a skin for every skater in this trendy skinpack!

+ Cute skater-themed outfits!
+ 16 custom skins for you to choose from!

items.title: Craftable: Bunkers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Live life to the fullest... underground! Craft yourself one of 10 beautiful bunkers to survive, thrive, and relax in.

- Includes 10 different bunker styles: high-tech, government, cave, farm, prison, creeper, lucky block, lava, luxury, and survival
- Easy to use Craftidex recipe system
- Unique building system with nudge, rotation, and undo
- By 57Digital

items.title: Modern Teen Mobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
You can either be a cute little slime or a scary creeper. Choose yours, have fun and don't forget to scare your friends!

- 6 teen mobs included
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Noel Design.

items.title: Teen Skaters
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Skating is a part of everyday life for these teens! You can find them training in the skate park or performing stunts in front of a huge audience!

- 12 teen skaters
- 2 free skins included
- Play with your friends!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Rich Farmers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Selling your crops to villages has made you a fortune! Work together with the other rich farmers to expand your empire and sell your crops all over the world!

- 12 farmers
- 2 free skins
- Farmer roleplay
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: PrestonPlayz Secret Pranks
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Time to start fooling around! Trick your friends with fake TNT, spawners, chests, and more. Get Preston’s 17 secret pranks skins today!

- 1 free Preston skin
- 17 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Among Spaceship - Impostors
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
You are the captain of a huge intergalactic spaceship. As you step out to explore a nearby asteroid, your crew calls you back in horror. "There are impostors among us" they say. "Space monsters have invaded our ship."
Fly back to your ship and destroy the invading impostors. It's time to save your crewmates. Good luck!

*Challenging game play
*8 sus imposter skins inside!

items.title: Rocket Brutes
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Eradicate zombies that plague your world, and look good doing it with this skin pack of geared-up brutes awaiting your command. With uniform colors accompanied by unique helmets and visors, you'll intimidate anyone coming your way.

- 8 armored skins to choose from
- Each skin depicts certain classes and roles
- By Thezi & Pathway Studios

items.title: Hostile Reimagined
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Looking to up the spookiness levels in your town? Look no further, because this skin pack is full of terrifying monsters redesigned to give you and your counterparts nightmares. Become the zombie you were meant to be!

- Includes 8 highly detailed monster-themed skins
- Each skin is inspired by an existing monster with an HD makeover!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: The Endless Invasion
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
The aliens have landed! Play with friends or fight alone against a never-ending wave of aliens.
Use lightning storms, bee swarms, electric orbs and more to defend your farm. 
Survive at all costs and don’t get abducted! 

- 3 custom alien mobs
- Earn tickets to buy unique weapons and items
- Play again and again and try to beat your high score

items.title: Adventurer's Journey
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
There are many valuable treasures in the castle. 
Defeat the boss in each room and reach the top of the castle. 
Hear ye! It is time for adventure! 

- Survival mode recommended 
- 1 to 4 players 
- You will find special treasures 
- A castle where treasures lie 

Build by Tanukiya

items.title: Summer 2021
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Party with the pros. Summer 2021 is here. 
Be stylish in the sun with this cool skin pack. 
One free skin!

items.title: God Tools
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
God tools is a base with the most powerful tools in Minecraft. Have you ever wanted to be the most OP player in the world? Explore this world and discover all the god tools, weapons, armor and items!

- God tools and weapons
- OP armor
- Massive castle base world
- Great survival or roleplay fun

By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Monster City World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Monster City World is a scary world that's perfect for anyone looking for a extra scare. This city is filled with monsters. Can you survive and rebuild humanity?

+ City world that is filled with scary monsters
+ Great for horror survival fans
+ Great for roleplaying or playing survival mode

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Skyblock Speedrun
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Skyblock Speedrun helps you to keep tack of the time it takes you to complete this skyblock world. When you are ready, hit the timer and see how long it takes you to defeat the Ender Dragon! Record and share your Skyblock Speedrun high scores with the world!

- Skyblock world
- Speedrun timer that keeps track of the time

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: City!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
+ City world
+ Different types of cars to drive around the city with
+ Includes skins
+ Survival or city roleplay

*The cars can only be used in the city world template!

items.title: Furniture
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Welcome to Furniture! Decorate and customize your million dollar mansion neighborhood with a ton of furniture to choose from. Use this furniture for roleplaying, creative mode, and survival mode.

- Furniture to decorate with
- Million dollar mansions

items.title: Speedrun World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Speedrun World helps you to keep tack of the time it takes you to complete Minecraft. When you are ready, hit the timer and see how long it takes you to defeat the Ender Dragon! Don't waste any time. Test your Minecraft skills. Record and share your Speedrun World high scores!

- Speedrun timer
- Basic survival spawn world

items.title: DOGS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
DOGS are the best animals in the world. Choose any of these cute pet dogs for your next Minecraft adventure. Woof-Woof!

- Includes 10 pet dog skins
- Tons of different breeds to choose from

items.title: Cosmic Teens
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
This one is for space lovers! Aliens invaded the city, and the teens came in to fight the evil forces. Be the hero of the story with this fantastic pack and bring peace back to the town! Choose the skin that fits your fantasy best. GAME ON! 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Armor of the Gods
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to be a god? Wear their armor!

+ 10 armored god skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Cute Couples
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as an adorable couple!

+ 16 skins included!
+ By Nitric Concepts
